# PDF.js

`pdf.min.mjs`, `pdf.worker.min.mjs`, and `LICENSE` are unmodified files from the
`pdfjs-dist` npm package, version **4.10.38**, distributed under Apache-2.0.

- Project and source: <https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/tree/v4.10.38>
- Distribution: <https://www.npmjs.com/package/pdfjs-dist/v/4.10.38>
- Downloaded from: `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/pdfjs-dist@4.10.38/`

The application lazy-loads the renderer after compilation. These files are
served locally with the site; runtime preview does not use a CDN.
